The circuit diagram shows two identical lamps connected in parallel to a cell. Three ammeters, X,
Y and Z, are also connected in the circuit, as shown.
X
A
Y
A
Z
A
Which statement about the current in X is correct?
A
It is equal to the current in Y and to the current in Z.
B
It is less than either the current in Y or the current in Z.
C
It is equal to the sum of the current in Y and the current in Z.
D
It is equal to the difference between the current in Y and the current in Z.

options.label: A
options.text: It is equal to the current in Y and to the current in Z.
